test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On May 20, 2025, the Supreme Court has made minimum how many years of legal practice mandatory for entry into the judicial service?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**3 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Supreme Court of India** has made it mandatory for individuals aspiring to join the judicial service to have a minimum of **3 years of legal practice** starting from **May 20, 2025**.
 
• This decision ensures that judicial officers have adequate **practical experience** in the field of law, which is vital for performing their duties efficiently.
 
• The move aims to enhance the **quality of judgments** by ensuring judges have a firm understanding of **legal procedures** and the **real-world challenges** faced by lawyers.
 
• The requirement aligns with the judiciary's broader goal of maintaining a **high standard of justice delivery** in India.
 
• It is also expected to encourage lawyers to gain sufficient **courtroom exposure** before transitioning to the judicial service, ensuring a balanced and practical approach to decision-making.
 
• This reform is part of a larger framework to strengthen the **judicial infrastructure** and ensure the appointment of qualified and experienced professionals to judicial positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Important Context about Judicial Services:**__

 __
 
• The judicial service in India forms the backbone of the country’s **judicial administration**.
 
• It includes roles like **Judicial Magistrates** and **District Judges**, which are essential for the functioning of the **lower judiciary.**
 
• The requirement of prior legal practice helps ensure that judges have a **practical understanding** of legal disputes and courtroom dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Potential Impact of the 3-Year Rule:**__
 
 
• This rule is likely to create a pool of **well-trained and experienced candidates** for judicial appointments.
 
• The reform aligns with the judiciary's aim to enhance **efficiency, transparency, and accountability** in the justice delivery system.
